sentences.text: Menaspis was an extinct genus of holocephalian cartilaginous fish that lived during the Wuchiapingian stage of the Permian period.
The genus Menaspis was described by Ewald in 1848.
The only known species in the genus is Menaspis armata.
Scientists have found eight recorded fossil occurrences of this species.
This animal is classified within the class Chondrichthyes.
It belongs to the family Menaspidae.
